summary: Implementation plan to remove 'NFL vs RedZone', partition 24/7 live TV channels (Sky Sports Golf, Tennis Channel, Rally TV, NHL Network, NFL Network, Fox League, Fox Cricket, Willow Cricket) into a dedicated '24/7 Live Sports TV Channels' section positioned above the match schedule in the Sports Arena, style them with high-contrast network cards and 24/7 LIVE badges, and preserve head-to-head match purity in both the match schedule and the Home view.
